cotidiano_mon: Hello, darling! Starting the week in the desert is just like ending it...#$b#Lots of sand and lots of sun.$h
cotidiano_tue: Sometimes I just stare out the window hoping to see Pam's bus.#$b#It's the only excitement I get all day.$s
cotidiano_wed: Make sure you drink plenty of water, farmer.#$b#I don't want you passing out at the door of my shop.$h
cotidiano_thu: I spend all day sweeping the sand that blows through the door.#$b#It's a losing battle, but at least it keeps me busy.$h
cotidiano_fri: Finally, it's Friday!$h#$b#Although every day feels exactly the same here at the Oasis...$s
cotidiano_sat: Do you have any interesting plans for the weekend in the valley?#$b#I'll probably just stay here... selling seeds.$h
cotidiano_sun: Sundays are very quiet around here.#$b#I almost miss the noise of the city.$s
cotidiano_mon4: I'm always happy to see you walk through that door, darling.#$b#You're my star customer.$h
cotidiano_tue4: I wonder if Emily will like the Cactus I sent her.#$b#I hope she doesn't prick her fingers watering it.$s
cotidiano_wed4: Hey, if you ever get tired of growing parsnips...#$b#You can always come help me sort starfruit seeds.$h
cotidiano_thu4: That blazing sun doesn't seem to bother you at all.#$b#You must be in great shape with all that farm work.$h
cotidiano_fri4: How's the farm? I'm sure your crops are beautiful this time of year.$h
cotidiano_sat4: Sometimes Mr. Qi makes strange noises upstairs...#$b#I try to ignore it by thinking about nice things, like my friends in the valley.$h
cotidiano_sun4: I tried to read a book yesterday, but I fell asleep because of the heat.#$b#Life in the desert makes you a little lazy.$h
lluvia_mon: Is it raining on your farm today? The sun always shines here...#$b#But sometimes I miss the smell of wet earth in Pelican Town.$s
lluvia_tue: Take advantage of the fact that you don't have to water your crops today.#$b#Why don't you stay a little longer and keep me company?$h
lluvia_thu: Emily told me the weather is terrible over there today.#$b#How lucky you have this little oasis to escape the rain!$h
lluvia_sat6: When it rains in the valley, I always imagine what it would be like to have a real garden.#$b#Cactus are cute, but I miss fresh flowers.$s
invierno_mon: Sometimes the customers who come from the valley bring a little snow on their shoes.#$b#It melts so fast here...$s
invierno_tue: Ugh, I don't miss the valley's winter at all. I hate the cold.$s#$b#The temperature here in the desert is perfect all year round.$h
invierno_thu4: Make sure to bundle up well when you go back home.#$b#I don't want you catching a cold and stopping your visits, farmer.$h
invierno_sun: How's the farm doing with the snow? It must be tough not being able to plant much.$s#$b#If you need rare seeds, you know where to find me.$h
cantera_wed: Emily wrote to me saying the mountain bridge finally works. It had been broken for years!#$b#I wonder what kind of gems and minerals are hiding in that old quarry...
cantera_thu6: If you ever find iridium in that old quarry, you should keep it.#$b#It's worth its weight in gold... well, much more than gold, actually.$h
cantera_fri: I heard you've been exploring the old quarry.#$b#If you find any pretty, shiny minerals, remember your friend Sandy!$h
llave_sun: That key you're carrying... it vibrates with a very dark energy.$s#$b#It belongs to the cave just northwest of here.#$b#Be very careful if you decide to enter, I've seen horrible things come out of there.$s
llave_mon6: Sometimes, at night, I hear muffled noises coming from the Skull Cavern.$s#$b#I'm glad the door is locked... although it seems you're planning to open it.
llave_tue8: Please, be careful down there.#$b#Promise me you'll come back in one piece. The desert is unforgiving, but what's in that cave is much worse.$s
isla_mon: I've heard rumors that you've been traveling to a tropical island. White sand, coconut trees, and sea breeze?#$b#Sounds much better than the dust and cactus here... Take me in your suitcase next time!$h
isla_tue: They say exotic fruits grow on that island that aren't seen here or in the valley.#$b#You should bring me a seed someday.$h
isla_wed: Did you bring me any souvenirs from the Ginger Islands?$h#$b#I hope you at least remembered to wear sunscreen, that sun burns differently than ours.
isla_fri8: With so much traveling to the island, I'm surprised you still have time to visit me in the desert.#$b#You make me feel very special, darling.$h
casino_thu: That golden card sticking out of your pocket... So you've been given access to the back room, huh?#$b#Be careful with Mr. Qi, darling. He's a very strict businessman.$s
casino_sat: Sometimes I hear strange noises coming from the back hallway. I prefer not to ask.$s#$b#They pay me very well to be the smiling face of the store.$h
casino_sun: The bouncer at the door gives me the creeps.$s#$b#I try not to look him in the eye. Where does Mr. Qi find these people?
fest_luau: Tomorrow is the Luau, right? I'm so jealous...$s#$b#My only party here is watching tumbleweeds go by and listening to scorpions.$s
fest_espiritus: Tomorrow is Spirit's Eve.#$b#You should come hide with me in the desert. Ghosts can't stand this heat!$h
pam_tue: I see you get along very well with Pam.#$b#She scares me a little when she gets off the bus cursing from a hangover,$s but I guess deep down she has a good heart.$h
pam_thu: Sometimes I offer Pam a little water when it's really hot...#$b#But she always mumbles something about it 'ruining her streak'. Poor woman.$s
emily_wed: Emily has always had incredible energy.$h#$b#I'm glad to know she has someone like you around to share it with.
emily_sat: Hey... Emily has been talking about you a lot in her letters lately. I think she likes you.#$b#She's a sweetheart, please take good care of her.#$b#If you break her heart, I'll have to ban you from the Oasis.$s
sve_sophia_mon: That pink-haired girl you told me about... Sophia, right? I love her style.#$b#She should come to the Oasis someday and try on my dresses.$h
sve_sophia_thu: I tried the wine your friend Sophia makes. It's delicious!$h#$b#She's very talented for someone so young, although she seems a bit shy.$s
sve_claire_tue: I know how hard it is to be behind a counter all day serving people.#$b#Tell Claire I send her my best from the desert.$h
mat_gen_mon: I never thought you'd settle down so quickly in the valley.#$b#Married life seems to suit you wonderfully, you have a special glow.$h
mat_gen_wed: I heard there was a wedding in the valley. Oh my!$h#$b#So someone managed to capture your heart, huh? I wish you the best of luck in your marriage.$h
mat_gen_sat: Hey, now that you're married, I hope your partner doesn't get jealous of you coming to the desert to see me so much.#$b#Tell them we're just good friends!$h
mat_emily_mon: I still can't believe you married my best friend!$h#$b#I hope you're giving her a wonderful life on the farm.$h
mat_emily_wed: The other day I saw a beautiful dress in a catalog and thought of Emily.$h#$b#I'm sure now that she's on the farm she has less time to sew.$s
mat_emily_thu: How is married life? Tell Emily I miss her so much.$s#$b#She should come visit me soon!$h
sve_mat_sophia_wed: I heard you married Sophia! You make an adorable couple.$h#$b#Let's see if you can get her out of her vineyard a bit and bring her to visit me.
sve_mat_sophia_fri: I hope Sophia is decorating the farm with lots of pink and pretty things.$h#$b#They would make a nice contrast with the sand here.
sve_mat_olivia_thu: Well, well... So you married Olivia. You're valley high society now, huh?$h#$b#I hope you don't forget your old friend Sandy when you're drinking expensive champagne.$h
poly_hermanas_tue: Darling, you have to tell me your secret!$h#$b#I heard you married my dear Emily... and also her sister! Wow, you really have energy.$h
poly_hermanas_thu: I wonder what the dynamic is like in that house with the two sisters.#$b#Haley was always a bit... special.$s I hope they don't drive you crazy.$h
poly_hermanas_fri: So you have a farm full of wives, huh?$h#$b#Hey, if you ever have room for a desert girl in that collection of yours... let me know. I could use a change of scenery.$h
poly_goticos_mon: You really know how to pick them, don't you?$h#$b#Those two always seemed inseparable. I guess you found a way to join their little club.$h
poly_goticos_thu: I heard the rumors, farmer. Married to Sebastian and Abigail at the same time...#$b#You must have a monopoly on dark hair dye in that house.$h#$b#If you're ever looking for a blonde to balance things out, you know where to find me!$h
poly_sve_coloridas_tue: Emily and Sophia... You married the two most colorful girls in the whole region!$h#$b#Your house must look like a rainbow of fabric and wine. I'm so jealous!$h
poly_sve_manson_mon: Darling, the rumors about you are flying all the way to the desert...$s#$b#Married to Olivia and also her son Victor? That's expert level. You have to tell me all the details.$h
alta_mon6: Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I had stayed in Pelican Town.$s#$b#I'd probably work at JojaMart or something depressing like that...$s I'm happy to be here.$h
alta_tue6: The desert has its own charm, don't you think? It's quiet, peaceful...$h#$b#And it lets me wear my favorite summer clothes all year round.$h
alta_wed8: You know, I was a little unsure about you when you first started coming to the desert.#$b#But you've become someone very special to me. Thank you for always visiting.$h
alta_fri8: Have you ever felt like you're trapped in a place, but at the same time you don't want to leave?$s#$b#It's a strange feeling.$s
alta_sun10: Don't tell anyone, but you're my favorite customer.$h#$b#Actually, at this point, you're much more than a customer.$h
marr_morn_0: Good morning, sugar cube! Ready to get your hands dirty on the farm today?$h#$b#I'll stay here a little longer admiring the green of the valley.$h
marr_morn_1: Mmm, is it day already? The bed is so comfortable...$h#$b#I wish you didn't have to go to work so early.$s
marr_rain_0: Look on the bright side, darling. With this rain you don't have to go out and water...#$b#So you have more time to cuddle with me inside!$h
marr_rain_1: I'll never get used to seeing so much water fall from the sky.#$b#In the desert, this would be a miracle.
marr_in_0: The farm is beautiful, but I'd be lying if I said I didn't miss the scorching sun of the Oasis a little bit.$s#$b#Just a little bit.$h
marr_in_1: I've been thinking about decorating the living room a bit. Do you think a couple of cacti would look good?$h#$b#To give it a touch of home...$h
marr_out_0: Breathing fresh air without swallowing desert dust...$h#$b#Marrying you was definitely the best decision I've ever made.$h
marr_out_1: I love walking around the farm. You've done an incredible job with this place, my love!$h
marr_night_0: Come to bed soon, darling.$h#$b#The work on the farm never ends, but you need to rest.$s
marr_night_1: It's been a long day.$s#$b#Come here and tell me what you've been doing in the valley while I was gone.$h
mail_2: Hello, farmer.^The desert is quieter than usual today. Sometimes I like the peace, but other times I wish I could hear the birds of Pelican Town. Anyway, I'm glad to know someone reads my letters. ^Drop by and say hi when you can. ^- Your friend, Sandy
mail_3: Hello sweetie!^I found this lying near the Oasis this morning. I thought you'd like a little piece of the desert on your farm. Don't eat it all at once! ^- Sandy %item object 88 1 %%
mail_4: Hey...^Have you ever wondered about that bouncer guarding the hallway in my shop? Sometimes he brings me tea, but he never says a word. It gives me the creeps, but I guess it's good to have security. ^Hope you're having a good day. ^- Sandy
mail_5: Sweetie!^Emily sent me a package full of fabric she wasn't going to use. It's too much for me, so I thought I'd share my loot with you. Maybe you can make something nice with it. ^- Sandy %item object 428 2 %%
mail_6: A little secret...^Did you know my real name isn't Sandy? I gave it to myself when I got here because... well, I live surrounded by sand! It's silly, but I feel like this is my true identity now. Thanks for accepting me the way I am. ^- Sandy
mail_7: A special gift!^I was checking the premium seed inventory at the Oasis and decided to secretly save some for you. They're very valuable, so make sure to plant them in summer or in your greenhouse. I know you'll do wonders with them! ^- Love, Sandy %item object 486 3 %%
mail_8: To my favorite farmer,^The heat was unbearable today, but thinking about our chats made me smile. You're one of the best things that's happened to this old desert in a long time. I'm sending you a little sample of the exclusive rhubarb seeds I sell here. Try them on your farm! ^- Sandy %item object 474 5 %%
mail_10: My dear farmer,^I never thought I'd find someone so special while stuck behind the counter of the Oasis. You've made my life here much less lonely. I'm sending you this so that, no matter how busy you are in the valley, you always have a way to come see me. ^I'll be waiting for you. ^- Sandy %item object 261 3 %%
sve_morris_thu: Have you heard about that Morris guy? Emily told me he's turning the town into a big Joja city... I hope he doesn't set his sights on my Oasis.$s
sve_lance_mon: A very strange warrior passed through here the other day. His name was Lance. He asked me if I'd seen any monsters in the dunes... He gave me the creeps.$h
sve_susan_sat: Susan sent me a basket of mountain jam. She's such a lovely woman! She says her farm is very peaceful... I relate to her, living a bit far from everyone else.$h
